title: Pay with Cab compared with Sam Wooding
summary: Cab's band was the first where he was paid well, whereas he knew Wooding underpaid him.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: So, did you get anymore money out of

Well we were paid, I thought, very well. I thought so because I tell you the truth, that was the first band that I had worked with that I was getting paid well. I thought I was getting paid well, because I'd been -- I was never paid well until I joined Cab Calloway's band. Sam Wooding paid what he paid off, but I was being underpaid the whole time I was with that band, I knew it. I was young, you know, and anxious to go to Europe, but Sam -- Cab, to me I thought I was getting very well paid.
